svg.text: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES | DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION | REGION I | SDO ILOCOS NORTE
Dumalneg National High School - PostgreSQL 15.x 3NF Schema & Row-Level Security

g.text: 1. RELATIONAL DATABASE ARCHITECTURE & OBJECT INHERITANCE MODEL (3NF)
The backend is engineered on PostgreSQL 15 via Supabase Cloud. It utilizes an Object-Relational Inheritance Model where the base users table handles authentication & RBAC,
while specialized sub-tables manage role-specific domains. Schedule slots, sections, and intake cycles are dynamically bound to active academic_terms (zero hardcoded dates).
FK: user_id | LRN, PSA, Isnag, 4Ps, SNEd
2. CORE RELATIONAL TABLE DEFINITIONS & DATA DICTIONARY
TABLE: public.students (DepEd Basic Education Learner Profile)
Dumalneg: Cabaritan, Kalabakan, Quibel, San Isidro
TABLE: public.sections (DepEd Class Capacity & Section Allocations)
TABLE: public.academic_terms (Dynamic Academic Calendar & Trimester State)
Exactly one active term enforced across system
3. KERNEL ROW-LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) & ROLE ACCESS CONTROL MATRIX
4. STORAGE SECURITY (ENROLLMENT-DOCUMENTS) & RA 10173 DATA PRIVACY COMPLIANCE
10 MB server ceiling (Enforced < 350 KB client canvas)
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
No direct unauthenticated URLs permitted. Documents are signed.
In-browser preview tokens expire automatically after 300 seconds.
All database volumes and file objects encrypted using AES-256.
Strict TLS 1.3 cipher suites across all client-to-Supabase streams.
Explicit parental consent collected at Step 5 of enrollment stepper.
Birth certificate & 4Ps household identifiers isolated from public query.
Registrar adjudication actions, status modifications, and document
inspections are timestamped with staff user identity keys.
Only fields officially required by the DepEd Basic Education
Enrollment Form (Revised 06/01/2025) are persisted in the database.
